housing-numbers.notes: Plan aims to exceed London Plan target of 3,950 homes 2007/8-2016/17. For 15-year period 2010/11-2024/25, planning for approximately 11,000 homes. Major growth focused in strategic areas: Central Leeside (up to 5,000), North Circular (up to 2,000), Enfield Town (500), North East Enfield (1,000). Small sites allowance of 274 per year for windfall.
